g.data-power-scope: the highest mode the Safety Manual lists, 8 x 25GS-PON; GPON mode is 71 W max (66 typ), XGS-PON 89 (84), MPM XGS/GPON 95 (90). Includes the optics, per the note that PON line-card figures include their optics
